dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did you come to own this shop?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Why did I open this shop, you ask? It's because of my dad.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: He's the Master of the Adventurers' Guild, Mondstadt Branch. He always brings tons of treasures after each adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: He'll then tell me the story behind each of the treasures... He was my hero when I was little.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: I wanted to share these stories with everyone, so I opened this shop—

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: But not long after opening, my dad became a bit more doddery and talks to himself all day...
